stage: v29 bounded forward escrow for roaming clients under multi-IP noise

unchanged_return_recovery_bounds.workspace: one reusable current-batch arena and slice headers; payload size bounded by the selected attempt,at most2MiB extra transient storage; typical128x204bytes about25.5KiB; retained ciphertext never mutated

method.sources: 4or16IPv4 aliases40..55 on one disposable generator VM,NIC and MAC;64UDP sockets distributed evenly across aliases. Total25000pps,not perIP. One shared4096-packet paced burst schedule;independent hosts/phases or source churn not modeled.
method.qualification: Sender per-IP successful-send counts equal independent Windows Ethernet-switch counts exactly;all1,750,000noise datagrams percase;Linux ingress rate also qualified within1%.
method.WAN: RTT300ms,30ms jitter each direction,half RTT netem delay each A-B direction including mTLS;queue16384,no configured random loss;20physical pings before each case.
method.useful: 6000UDPdatagrams/s,128-byte payload,60s requested;upload/download tested.100ordinary probes perprofile plus100frequent at50ms. Same1s deadline.
method.mobility: One existing native peer moves IP/NATport3times;nextmove250ms after prior conntrack deletion ends. Second native peer stationary. Profiles,keys,listenports,client binaries and v27 recovery budgets unchanged.
method.pairing: Four matched baseline/escrow pairs; same seed within each source-count/direction pair, varied AB/BA order. Individual netem draws and host scheduling need not match.
method.observation: Noise counters cover40..55;ingressTC instrumentation uses32/27,which includes no client addresses30/31. Forwarding path unchanged;16bounded switch counters added. Live nft aggregate rate/burst checked before every load.
method.CPU: No quota/threshold;all nominal250ms guest CPU samples retained and weighted means computed from accumulated ticks. Upload outer captures have more cost than lean download captures.
method.payload: Same fresh captured-prefix fixture with unusable transport body as prior studies. No valid peer credentials given to noise sender.
method.build: Only the new entry C process compiled offline before the final matrix. Existing v27 B binary, client profiles/binaries, switch and noise generator unchanged. No build or package installation during measurements.
method.admission: Baseline6000/s burst2048; candidate5936/s burst1984 plus first-conntrack-packet64/s burst64. Sum stays6000/s burst2048. Both retain source1500/s burst4096. Accounting enabled in both. Kernel lease rechecked in separate hook after queue101 release.
method.unique_delivery: Set difference of per-datagram UDP sequence numbers in sender/receiver inner captures; does not use iperf inferred loss as a unique-delivery result. One-second ping deadline unchanged; late replies counted separately.

preliminary_failures.label: e4u1
preliminary_failures.reason: Early daemon exit without diagnostic. Added netlink type/error diagnostics and changed queue POLLERR handling to receive/account the socket error rather than exit at poll. Exact cause of the first exit cannot be established from its original log.

preliminary_failures.label: e4u2
preliminary_failures.reason: Measurement assertion omitted released packets bypassing queue100. Residual1362 exactly matched escrow_current1362. Corrected accounting subtracts the independent kernel release counter; final cases require residual zero.

limits: Four/16fixed noise IPv4 aliases,64ports on one generator,NIC and shared burst scheduler;not independent remote hosts or sustained source/port churn.
One moving native peer and one stationary native peer;GUI clients,DPI,simultaneous moving peers,IPv6,jumbograms,higher rates and different server kernels untested.
Retention is bounded and also stores noise;proof delay or memory/flow/queue exhaustion can still lose client packets. No guaranteed1s application latency.
Tuple spoofing remains possible on a currently leased address/port;B still authenticates every VPN packet. Candidate-count exhaustion and link saturation remain outside this fix.
RAM figures include measured daemon RSS/HWM and maximum retained wire bytes;total peak kernel skb/slab RAM was not measured.
